name: active-agent
description: Muse Code coding/explanation sessions, change tracking, walkthrough planning, Phonon narration and local history for Active.

active.muse.binaryPath.description: Path to the `muse` CLI. Empty searches PATH and ~/.local/bin.

active.walkthrough.backgroundTimeoutSeco.description: How long to wait for background tasks (tests, builds) after a coding turn before explaining. Unfinished checks are marked pending; the tasks keep running.

active.explain.minMeaningfulLines.description: Meaningful changed lines (excluding whitespace, comments and moves) that make a single turn worth explaining. Turns are assessed independently.

active.explain.draftQuietSeconds.description: Quiet period after the last change before drafting the walkthrough while the agent is still working.

active.narration.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter with the `ptts` package (Phonon). Empty uses .tools/tts-venv or ~/.active/tts-venv.

active.dev.agentBackend.description: DEV ONLY. `bridge` serves the coding and explanation sessions from external agents (e.g. Claude Code subagents) through a mailbox directory instead of Muse Code.

active.dev.bridgeDir.description: DEV ONLY. Mailbox directory for the `bridge` agent backend.
